seriesTitle: Total Drama Presents: The Ridonculous Race

episodes.title: None Down, Eighteen to Go – Part 1
episodes.summary: We meet the 18 teams competing for 1 million dollars in the most brutal race ever.

episodes.title: None Down, Eighteen to Go – Part 2
episodes.summary: Our teams discover a variety of spices in a stew-pendous Moroccan challenge.

episodes.title: French is an Eiffel Language
episodes.summary: Our teams explore the catacombs under the streets of Paris in the cheesiest episode yet!

episodes.title: Mediterranean Homesick Blues
episodes.summary: The teams face sharks, sandcastle building and evil sabotage.

episodes.title: Bjorken Telephone
episodes.summary: Our teams learn that speaking Icelandic might be best left to the Icelanders.

episodes.title: Brazilian Pain Forest
episodes.summary: Coconuts and Carnival costumes greet our teams in Rio, but it's not all fun and games!

episodes.title: Tisket, a Casket, I'm Gonna Blow a Gasket
episodes.summary: Things get super spooky for our teams when they arrive in Transylvania.

episodes.title: Hawaiian Honeyruin
episodes.summary: Our teams take a blistering stroll in Hawaii and some duos reach boiling point.

episodes.title: Hello and Dubai
episodes.summary: Our lucky teams go to the most beautiful hotel in the world… and wash it's windows.

episodes.title: New Beijinging
episodes.summary: It's a rickshaw race to the Chill Zone at the Great Wall of China.

episodes.title: I Love Ridonc & Roll
episodes.summary: There's frozen fun in Finland as our teams take each other on in an air guitar contest.

episodes.title: My Way or Zimbabwe
episodes.summary: It's anything but plain sailing when the teams have to raft over Victoria Falls!

episodes.title: Shawshank Ridonc-tion
episodes.summary: Just how long will it take the teams to breakout of a maximum-security Australian prison?

episodes.title: Down and Outback
episodes.summary: We discover that some teams don't know the difference between a rabbit and a kangaroo.

episodes.title: Maori or Less
episodes.summary: Our teams perform a traditional Maori dance and someone makes a truly permanent mistake.

episodes.title: Little Bull on the Prairie
episodes.summary: The teams must take the (mechanical) bull by the horns to ride into the next round.

episodes.title: Lord of the Ring Toss
episodes.summary: The teams warm-up in the arctic circle with a game of ring toss with some local narwhals.

episodes.title: Got Venom?
episodes.summary: Can our teams collect some saliva from Komodo dragons in Indonesia?

episodes.title: Dude Buggies
episodes.summary: The teams have a choice between magic tricks and dune buggies in Vegas.

episodes.title: El Bunny Supremo
episodes.summary: The teams have a wild Mexican adventure that includes hot peppers, cliff dives and burros.

episodes.title: Ca-Noodling
episodes.summary: The six remaining teams must become two teams; the Axis of Evil is created.

episodes.title: How Deep is Your Love?
episodes.summary: Most of the teams play it safe in Russia, but one duo takes a risk. Will they lose it all?

episodes.title: Darjeel with It
episodes.summary: Our teams go tea picking in India, but have some train trouble thanks to one pair.

episodes.title: Last Tango in Buenos Aires
episodes.summary: The final four dance their way to the final three, but who will face their final curtain?

episodes.title: Bahamarama
episodes.summary: As the final begins, our teams search for maps to help them locate treasure.

episodes.title: A Million Ways to Lose a Million Dollars
episodes.summary: The teams give it all they've got to win the million dollars in the grand finale.
